tools.name: check_step
tools.description: Call AFTER each tool call or agent step with what you just did and whether it failed. Loop Breaker fingerprints the call (tool + normalized args + error) and returns verdict ok, loop_detected or halted. Pro: on a loop, halt=true; stop the run, do not retry, and tell your user what repeated. Free wat

tools.name: loop_status
tools.description: Show a run's loops so far, whether it is halted, and its last 10 steps.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Draft a plain-English report of the last 7 days for your key (or IP): runs, loops caught, wasted repeat steps, and the worst offenders. Read-only; sends nothing. Show it to your user.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $49/month All Access upgrade link (cloudforbots.com/offer). Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.
